problem: eye dropper > inverts dark-mode canvas pixel when picking a color in dark theme: AssertionError: expected null not to be null at eyeDropper.test.tsx:119 (waitFor .excalidraw-eye-dropper-preview). Cause (checked in session): editorJotaiStore is module-level and not reset between tests; the file's first test leaves activeEyeDropperAtom set, so the trigger click toggles it closed. Fix: add beforeEach(() => { editorJotaiStore.set(activeEyeDropperAtom, null); }) at the top of describe("eye dropper"), importing activeEyeDropperAtom from "../components/EyeDropper" and editorJotaiStore from "../editor-jotai"; keep the trigger path and every assertion.
